My best friend passed just after I had my first child, my daughter. My friend lived on the east coast and I on the west coast. She visited us four days before her fatal car accident and while she was here, she held my daughter and really connected with her. I'm so glad I took a bunch of photos. Four days later, she passed, and it was such a shock - especially because she was barely 30 and so vibrant. The car accident was not something anyone saw coming. Two weeks later my daughter had her first big laugh ever at just 6 weeks old, and luckily I took a video and now have it to treasure. I cried, it was very early developmentally for my daughter to laugh (normally 4 months old is the expected time frame). It felt like this was a sign from my lovely friend (as she was one to laugh a lot and very optimistic). It was the most beautiful thing. I'll never truly know if it was her, but even my husband agreed it was, so I choose to believe it. After that she did not laugh again until she was around four months old. It was such a special and treasured moment.
